html:
Question 12
?

Find the projection of the intersection between the sphere x2+y2+z2=24 and the plane z+y=6 onto the xy-plane.

a
(x+3)23+(y+3)26=1
b
x26+(y−3)23=1
c
x23+(y+3)26=1
d
(x−3)26+y23=1
e
(x+1)212+(y−3)26=1
Submit
